sources.name: MarkTechPost
sources.summary: Mistral AI introduced Robostral Navigate, an 8B embodied navigation model. It moves robots from a plain-language instruction using only a single RGB camera, with no LiDAR or depth sensors. The model reaches 76.6% success on R2R-CE validation unseen through a pointing method, prefix-caching training, and CISPO online reinforcement learning. The post Mistral AI Releases Robostral Navigate: An 8B Model Enabling Robots to Navigate Complex Environments Using a Single RGB Camera appeared first on MarkTechPost .
